question: Found all over the world
solution: Music is often called a universal language. वह चीज़ जो पूरी दुनिया में व्याप्त या मान्य हो (सार्वभौमिक)।

question: Not yet used or developed
solution: The country has vast untapped natural resources. जिसे अभी तक उपयोग में न लाया गया हो या विकसित न किया गया हो।

question: Difficult to handle or manage due to size or weight
solution: The heavy sofa was quite unwieldy to move up the stairs. जो चीज़ अपने आकार या भार के कारण संभालने में कठिन हो।

question: Excessively fond of or submissive to one's wife
solution: He is quite uxorious and follows all his wife's instructions. जो अपनी पत्नी का बहुत ज़्यादा कहना मानता हो (जोरू का गुलाम)।

question: Having no moral principles
solution: The unscrupulous businessman cheated many innocent people. वह व्यक्ति जिसकी कोई नैतिकता या सिद्धांत न हों (अनैतिक)।

question: In a manner fully agreed upon by all
solution: The resolution was passed unanimously by the committee. ऐसी स्थिति जहाँ सभी लोग पूर्णतः सहमत हों (सर्वसम्मति से)।

question: A mythological animal with one horn on its forehead
solution: Unicorns are popular characters in children's fairy tales. एक सींग वाला घोड़े जैसा काल्पनिक पशु।

question: A large vase that usually has a pedestal or feet
solution: The ancient urn was decorated with beautiful patterns. एक बड़ा सजावटी बर्तन या कलश।

question: An imagined perfect society where everything is ideal
solution: A world without crime is a beautiful utopia. एक ऐसा आदर्श समाज जिसकी केवल कल्पना की जा सकती है।

question: One who lends money at unreasonably high interest
solution: In the story, the poor farmer was trapped by a greedy usurer. वह व्यक्ति जो बहुत ऊँची ब्याज दर पर पैसे उधार देता है (सूदखोर)।

question: The upward force that a fluid exerts on a body floating in it
solution: Upthrust is the reason why objects feel lighter in water. किसी तरल पदार्थ द्वारा ऊपर की ओर लगाया जाने वाला बल (उत्प्लावन बल)।

question: A rapid or sudden rise
solution: There has been an upsurge in interest in organic farming. किसी चीज़ की मात्रा या तीव्रता में अचानक होने वाली तेज़ वृद्धि।

question: The quality of being useful
solution: We should consider the utility of the product before buying it. किसी चीज़ के काम आने की विशेषता या उसकी उपयोगिता।

question: Not having knowledge or experience of a particular subject or activity
solution: To the uninitiated, the technical symbols can look very confusing. वह व्यक्ति जो किसी विषय या कार्य में नया हो (नौसिखिया)।

question: To improve skills to match new demands
solution: Many employees need to upskill to keep up with new technology. नई ज़रूरतों के अनुसार अपने कौशल या हुनर को बढ़ाना।

question: A person who shows people to their seats
solution: The usher showed us to our seats in the dark cinema hall. वह व्यक्ति जो थिएटर या चर्च में लोगों को उनकी सीट तक ले जाता है।

question: The practice of lending money at unreasonably high interest
solution: Some countries have strict laws to prevent usury. ऊँची और अनुचित ब्याज दर पर पैसे देने का व्यापार (सूदखोरी)।

question: Something never done or known before
solution: The company’s growth this year is completely unprecedented. जो पहले कभी न हुआ हो या जिसके बारे में पहले जानकारी न हो (अभूतपूर्व)।

question: A major change or disturbance especially one causing confusion
solution: The sudden resignation of the CEO caused a massive upheaval in the company. समाज या शासन व्यवस्था में होने वाली भारी और भ्रमित करने वाली उथल-पुथल।

question: Working in a job that does not fully use one's skills or abilities
solution: Many engineering graduates are underemployed, working in manual jobs. वह स्थिति जहाँ व्यक्ति की योग्यता के अनुसार उसे काम नहीं मिलता (अल्प-रोज़गार)।

question: The killing of one's wife
solution: In the tragic story, the king was driven to uxoricide. अपनी पत्नी की हत्या करने का अपराध।

question: Impossible to understand
solution: His handwriting was so messy that the note was completely unintelligible. वह बात या भाषा जो बिल्कुल समझ में न आए।

question: Not capable of being proved false
solution: The philosopher argued that some religious beliefs are unfalsifiable. ऐसा सिद्धांत या बात जिसे गलत सिद्ध करना नामुमकिन हो।

question: Fully agreed upon by all
solution: The board members reached a unanimous decision. वह निर्णय या विचार जिससे सभी लोग पूर्णतः सहमत हों।

question: Existing or being everywhere at the same time
solution: Today, smartphones are ubiquitous in almost every part of the world. वह चीज़ जो एक ही समय में हर जगह मौजूद हो (सर्वव्यापी)।

question: Beyond one's legal power or authority
solution: The court ruled that the government's action was ultra vires. जब कोई संस्था या अधिकारी अपनी कानूनी शक्ति की सीमा से बाहर कार्य करता है।

question: Poorly educated or illiterate
solution: In the 19th century, many people in the villages remained unlettered. वह व्यक्ति जिसे शिक्षा न मिली हो या जो अनपढ़ (illiterate) हो।
